GOAL: build and Lean-verify an improved APSP bound O(n^2.9955607132692) for bigospeedrun.com (current Lean Verified record 2.9955607647814). Do NOT submit anything anywhere and do NOT push to any remote.

1. In this folder, make a subfolder apsp-fractional-c. Clone https://github.com/fringewidth/apsp-bound into it and check out commit f1f7486411b8a59c351b2fbe75ee680f82ce0579 (new branch fractional-c).
2. Apply the patch below. It is gzip-compressed, then base64-encoded, on one line between the markers. Save that line to patch.b64, then decode it. In Git Bash: base64 -d patch.b64 | gunzip > fractional-c.patch. In PowerShell: [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes('p.gz',[Convert]::FromBase64String((Get-Content patch.b64 -Raw).Trim())), then gunzip. Then run git apply fractional-c.patch.
3. Install Lean through elan if it isn't present (toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.33.1, pinned in lean-toolchain). Then run lake exe cache get, then python3 scripts/build_sequential.py (see .github/workflows/verify.yml), then python3 verify.py.
4. What the patch does: it changes the tensor depth from c = 20 to c = 502/25. The program now computes L = ceil(502 m / 25) with the existing Proc.levels31 ceil-mul procedure (G20 has a=502, b=25) instead of L = 20 m. It sets theta = 225677/1996332, sigma = 152980/4570079, Gamma > 0.0663089654688, q < 0.4336910345308, B = (477/25) ln3/ln4 < 15.12054225688, and the exponent chain 2.9955607132669 / ...689 / ...690 / ...691 / ...692. Wherever the old proofs used L = 20 m, they now use L <= 21 m: the boxes constant 34560 becomes 36288, 76*72 becomes 80*72, N0 <= exp(B d + 2), 4^L <= exp(21 d), and ONeedPoly uses Y >= (16Q)^42 with polyBound 3360 840. The new numbers were checked in exact rational arithmetic, but the Lean was written without a compiler, so expect some compile errors. The files most likely to need fixes are Batch/OBound.lean, Batch/ORunParams.lean, Batch/ONeedPoly.lean, Batch/Numbers.lean and Batch/OProg.lean.
5. Fix compile errors until the build and verify.py pass. Rules: never use sorry, admit, native_decide or new axioms. Never edit Submission/EndStatement.lean. Keep the final theorem Race.bound at 14977803566346/5000000000000 (= 2.9955607132692) if at all possible. Intermediate constants (polynomial-factor constants, the +100 in absorb, the 21 in L <= 21 m, word-size bounds) may be loosened freely. If one inequality really can't hold at this exponent, you may raise the final exponent slightly, as long as it stays below 2.9955607647814. Say so if you do.
6. When verify.py passes, save git diff > final.patch and copy verification/ and verify.py's output into the apsp-fractional-c folder. Report: pass/fail, the final exponent, the files you changed beyond the patch, total build time, and the last 30 lines of verify.py output.
